notes.title: The Kickback local co-op playtest has started!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320909/dcb0234540ecb4558bafc3818706487ca540153c.png[/img]

You can now dive into the biopunk setting and be among the first to try out the new game mode! Don't forget to bring a partner along to battle mutants and work together to repair the broken engine of your battle vehicle.

A wide selection of weapons and perks will allow you to find the perfect combinations and fight off waves of enemies, and the permanent death feature will add an adrenaline rush!

To participate, visit the game's page on Steam and click the "Request Access" button

Join us! :)
